curator_note: Open-air, location-TBA and starting at 11 is the right recipe, but the billing is thin and I can't vouch for either name. A gamble worth a look if you're already out DTLA.
description: AXIS's Retrograde open-air party with Jack Faulkner and Jonny Cota, venue announced later.

curator_note: Blind Tiger's weekly late-night room at the Lex: no named bill, but tech-house and minimal until 5 is the pitch, and RSVP before 1 gets you in free. Reliable fallback when nothing bigger is calling.
description: Recurring Blind Tiger after-hours at The Lexington, tech-house and minimal from 11pm to 5am; free with RSVP before 1.

artist_notes.name: Sam Divine
artist_notes.note: UK house DJ with a long Defected and Ibiza association; the 555 party is her own brand.

curator_note: Sam Divine is a real UK tech-house name, and 1720's Arts District room suits her glossy, driving sets. Mixmag Lab branding means a bigger-production night than the usual Friday.
description: Mixmag Lab at 1720 in the Arts District with UK house DJ Sam Divine.

curator_note: Electroclash, hyperpop and witch house isn't the house/techno spine, so this is more costume-y alt-dance than club night. Skip unless that weirdness appeals.
description: UNDR's Undrween Halloween-season rave at a TBA DTLA location, electroclash, hyperpop and witch house.

curator_note: Same Nightshift format as the rest of the run: unannounced lineup, tech-house and minimal at the Lex until 5. Fine for a late DTLA stop.
description: Recurring Blind Tiger after-hours at The Lexington, tech-house and minimal from 11pm to 5am; free with RSVP before 1.

artist_notes.name: DJ Shroomie
artist_notes.note: LA deep-house DJ, co-founder of Low Recordings, the collective behind recurring free house nights around town.

curator_note: Vinyl, one DJ, 11 to 7 is exactly how a groove night should be built, and Certified Groovers does it with the location revealed late. Easily the best fit in this batch.
description: Certified Groovers all-night vinyl house set from DJ Shroomie at a TBA downtown location.

curator_note: Another Nightshift Friday, no names yet. Worth it for the hours and the free RSVP, not for the booking.
description: Recurring Blind Tiger after-hours at The Lexington, tech-house and minimal from 11pm to 5am; free with RSVP before 1.

curator_note: Closer's trance-meets-techno night with an LA debut for 6 Sense, which I can't place, so I'm leaning on the promoter. Four acts for $11-22 is cheap if the harder, trancier side appeals.
description: Closer presents Thermal, a trance and techno afterhours with 6 Sense making an LA debut plus fun2bjane, S.I.M and Brick.

curator_note: Nightshift again, lineup unlisted. It's an easy late-night default, nothing more.
description: Recurring Blind Tiger after-hours at The Lexington, tech-house and minimal from 11pm to 5am; free with RSVP before 1.

curator_note: Four-DJ Moondance bill at a secret DTLA spot running to 4:30. I only know the promoter crew, so judge it on their track record with Closer and TYF.
description: Closer, TYF and Delinquent's Moondance with Tres Mortimer, James Wyler, Ricart Maria and Somos2 at a TBA DTLA venue.

curator_note: A PNK Records label showcase under the Moondance banner, tech-house and minimal until 5. Pricey tiers at the top end, so grab early tickets.
description: Closer, TYF and PNK Records label party with Polovich and AKA Vinnie at a TBA DTLA venue.
